issues.title: Surfing-Simmers, Medina win first Philippines Pro in hollow typhoon surf
issues.title_en: Surfing-Simmers, Medina win first Philippines Pro in hollow typhoon surf
issues.summary: Nov 3 (Reuters) - Brazil's three-times world champion Gabriel ⁠Medina scored a near-perfect tube to win the inaugural Philippines Pro in heavy, hollow typhoon surf on Tuesday, while California's Caitlin Simmers overcame injury ⁠to win the women's event.
